def rels(a,b,R,C):
    ca=block_cells(*a); cb=block_cells(*b)
    d=min(max(abs(p[0]-q[0]),abs(p[1]-q[1])) for p in ca for q in cb)

    out={}

    for k in range(2,7): out[f'near{k}']= d<=k
    out['rowov']= not (a[0]+1<b[0] or b[0]+1<a[0])
    out['colov']= not (a[1]+1<b[1] or b[1]+1<a[1])
    # diagonal corner alignment: some corner of a and some corner of b on same diagonal

    out['manh2']=m<=2
